---
title: The craft.sh magic
---

To make it easier for you to get the files that are needed to practice in the class, we've created a small utility called `craft.sh`.

Please install it by running the following command:

```session
$ curl -fsSL https://craft-of-computing.anandology.com/2026/install.sh | bash
```

You could check if it working by checking its version:

```session
$ craft.sh version
craft 2
```

This would have created a craft directory in your home.

```session
$ cd
$ ls
craft ...
```

Let's check what is there. 

```session
$ ls craft
